https://vietnamnews.vn/politics-laws/179.text: Permanent Deputy PM receives Lithuanian Foreign Minister HÀ NỘI — Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Phạm Gia Túc received Lithuanian Minister of Foreign Affairs Kestutis Budrys in Hà Nội on Tuesday, saying that ample potential and room remain for cooperation between the two countries. Hailing the outcomes of Budrys’s talks with Vietnamese Minister of Foreign Affairs Lê Hoài Trung, Túc called his guest’s official visit a contribution to the traditional friendship between the two countries as well as the substantive development of the Việt Nam-EU Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. He suggested them expand ties across all fields, with a focus on enhancing political trust through mutual visits and meetings at all levels, particularly high levels. They should maximise existing cooperation mechanisms, boost economic, trade, and investment connections by effectively leveraging the EU-Việt Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA), strengthen business linkages, and expand cooperation in areas matching Lithuania’s strengths such as the digital economy, financial technology, energy (LNG infrastructure, renewable energy, grid development, and network synchronisation), seaports, maritime transport, logistics, and science – technology, the host said. Việt Nam stands ready to create optimal conditions for Lithuanian enterprises to explore the market and make long-term investment in the country, the Deputy PM affirmed. Túc called on Lithuania to continue voicing strong support for the remaining EU member states to swiftly ratify the EU-Việt Nam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA) and to advocate the European Commission's early removal of the "yellow card" warning on Việt Nam's seafood exports, particularly during Lithuania's rotating Presidency of the Council of the EU in the first half of 2027. He also proposed that the two sides expeditiously finalise the legal framework for cooperation, including the agreements on the avoidance of double taxation, visa exemption for official passport holders, education, training, and labour, while stepping up people-to-people exchanges. On this occasion, he requested that Lithuania continue creating favourable conditions for the Vietnamese community residing in the country, enabling them to fulfil their role as a bridge of friendship between the two nations. For his part, Budrys conveyed Lithuanian President Gitanas Nauseda’s invitation to Party General Secretary and State President Tô Lâm to pay an official visit to the European country at an early date. He also conveyed greetings and an invitation from Lithuanian PM Mindaugas Sinkevicius to PM Lê Minh Hưng. The minister spoke highly of Việt Nam's impressive development achievements, its increasingly important role in ASEAN, and the progress in Việt Nam-EU relations. Lithuania attaches great importance to its relations with Việt Nam and is ready to act as a bridge for promoting ties between Việt Nam and the EU, he affirmed, stating that during its upcoming rotating EU Presidency, Lithuania will prioritise the implementation of EU cooperation projects with Việt Nam, particularly in energy and transport infrastructure through the Global Gateway initiative. Agreeing with his host’s opinions, Budrys said Lithuania wishes to expand cooperation with Việt Nam in trade, investment, energy, cybersecurity, logistics, and agriculture, noting that it will send a business delegation to Việt Nam to explore cooperation and investment opportunities. In addition, he asked the two sides to promote labour collaboration, student exchanges and cultural ties reaffirming his country’s support for the EVIPA and the early lifting of the IUU fishing "yellow card". During the meeting, both host and guest emphasised their commitment to strengthening their countries’ coordination and mutual support at the United Nations and other multilateral forums, as well as to advancing ASEAN–EU relations. They reaffirmed the importance of maintaining peace, stability, security, safety, and freedom of navigation and overflight, and resolving disputes by peaceful means in accordance with international law, particularly the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). — VNA/VNS Politics & Law Việt Nam, Netherlands eye stronger cooperation in trade, technology and innovation Politics & Law Top Vietnamese leader attends inauguration of Việt Nam House, meets Vietnamese community in Australia Politics & Law Việt Nam, Australia seek to forge stronger bonds Politics & Law Việt Nam sends condolences to Colombia over earthquake losses Politics & Law Việt Nam–Australia Joint Statement on Economic Resilience Cooperation Politics & Law Việt Nam–Australia Joint Statement on Deepening Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Politics & Law Draft law proposes greater autonomy for HCM City and special-class cities Under the proposal, HCM City and cities officially classified as special-class urban centres would be eligible to apply special development mechanisms and policies. https://www.irishmirror.ie/news/irish-ne.text: The evil killer of pensioner James Ryan has been removed from the State this weekend just a week after completing her two year prison sentence for his killing - much to the relief of the Ryan family. Olesja Hertova, now 50 and originally from the Czech Republic, was re-arrested upon her release from The Dochas Centre at Mountjoy Prison on Thursday, September 17 by the Garda National Immigration Bureau (GNIB) on foot of an EU Removal Order. She was detained pending deportation. James’ relieved family have now confirmed she was removed from the State at the weekend, bringing an end to months of uncertainty for the Ryan family. James’s daughter Karen said: “It’s over.” Hertova, of Hastings Lawn, Balbriggan, Co Dublin, pleaded guilty at Dublin Circuit Criminal Court in July 2025 to the unlawful killing of Mr Ryan at their home on August 11, 2024. James (69), who lived in Balbriggan, suffered severe head injuries after Hertova “lost her temper” and pushed him forcefully to the ground. He was taken to Beaumont Hospital but died the following day. Hertova, who had been in a relationship with James for nearly 16 years, had been abusing him for years prior to taking his life. On Saturday, Karen confirmed Hertova was removed from the State “after more than two years of uncertainty, campaigning and a lengthy legal process.” “This was a long drawn out process and we fully appreciate that a decision of this nature is not made lightly,” Karen continued. Kanre said her family have always maintained that the full circumstances surrounding Ms Hertova’s previous history of physical, emotional and psychological violence should have been available to the sentencing court. “It remains our firm belief that, had the sentencing judge been made aware of the full history, it could have affected the sentence imposed,” she said. The family had also previously raised concerns about information and material which they said was not included in their family impact statements. While welcoming Hertova’s removal, Karen said the family remained disappointed with how they had been treated during the past two years. She said the family had repeatedly sought information about the deportation process and had faced uncertainty surrounding Hertova’s release. The family also had to seek protection through the courts, she said. “Our family has repeatedly been left having to find answers ourselves,” Karen said. “We should never have had to experience the level of uncertainty and fear that we have experienced.” Karen said she hoped the family’s experience would lead to greater consideration being given to victims and families following serious crimes, particularly where children, safeguarding concerns and fears about what happens when a sentence comes to an end are involved. “We will continue to speak about the need for victims and families to be properly informed, protected and heard,” she said. Karen also thanked everyone who had supported the family, shared James Ryan’s story and helped keep his name and story in the public eye. “Not one share, message or word of support went unnoticed,” she said. “We will be forever grateful.” The Garda Press Office has been contacted for a statement. https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/oc.text: Fishing boats on the sand after being pulled from the sea in preparation for the passage of Hurricane Trudy in Acapulco, Mexico. Photograph: Javier Verdin/Reuters View image in fullscreen Fishing boats on the sand after being pulled from the sea in preparation for the passage of Hurricane Trudy in Acapulco, Mexico. Photograph: Javier Verdin/Reuters Weatherwatch Mexico Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece Alice Nightingale-Smith and Nick Lee for MetDesk Mon 19 Oct 2026 06.07 EDT Last modified on Mon 19 Oct 2026 06.19 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday. Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico . By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted. In Greece , heavy rain and thunderstorms caused severe flooding and one fatality across Rhodes, Evia and the Sporades islands last week. According to the National Observatory of Athens, a station in Rhodes recorded 202mm between 3.30am and 9.50am (UTC) on 14 October. Regional authorities reported more than 30 rescue and extrication operations in response to flooding, while the Greek coastguard said four passenger vehicles were swept into the sea during the storm. On Skiathos, flood waters swept away two cars. View image in fullscreen Cars swept into the sea on the Greek island of Rhodes. Photograph: Kyriakos Finas/Reuters Five deaths were reported due to severe flooding in Istanbul, Turkey , last week. Heavy rain on 14 and 15 October prompted school closures, flight delays, disruptive flooding and landslides across several provinces. According to the Istanbul metropolitan municipality, 242mm of rain was recorded in Beykoz, a district of Istanbul province. Nearly 600 people were rescued after becoming stranded and at least 2,700 people were forced to evacuate their homes. The Turkish state meteorological service issued further alerts for heavy rain and thunderstorms over the weekend across dozens of provinces, with at least an additional 40-60mm forecast for parts of the Marmara and western Black Sea regions. https://hvg.hu/itthon/20261111_letartozt.text: A kényszerintézkedést egy hónapra rendelték el a volt miniszterelnök öccsével és annak élettársával szemben. Egy hónapra elrendelte Orbán Áron és élettársa letartóztatását a bíróság – írja a Telex a Fővárosi Törvényszék szóvivőjének tájékoztatása nyomán. Az úgynevezett vízumügyben később kiadott közleményben az olvasható, hogy a Budai Központi Kerületi Bíróság „O. Áron és F. Izabella terheltek letartóztatását egy hónapra elrendelte, G. Ben gyanúsítottal szemben 4 hónap időtartamra bűnügyi felügyeletet rendelt el. M. János esetében az ügyészség indítványát elutasította és nem rendelt el kényszerintézkedést, mert nem állapított meg olyan eljárási célt, amely korlátozás bevezetését indokolná”. A bíróságban egyik gyanúsított vonatkozásában sem merült fel észszerű kétely a bűncselekmény elkövetésének megalapozott gyanújával kapcsolatban. Az ügyészség a volt miniszterelnök öccsét és három társát üzletszerűen, bűnszövetségben elkövetett embercsempészéssel gyanúsítja, azzal, hogy több hónapon keresztül segítettek Vietnámból érkező embereknek illegálisan vízumhoz jutni. A hatóságok hétfőn fogták el Orbán Viktor volt miniszterelnök öccsét és három társát. Két helyszínen biztonsági okokból – mivel a lakásokban fegyverekre lehetett számítani – a Terrorelhárítási Központ műveleti egységei hajtották végre az elfogásokat , míg a további helyszíneken az ORFK Bűnügyi Ellátó Igazgatóság taktikai egységei. A letartóztatásukat kedden indítványozta a Fővárosi Főügyészség , mondván: fennáll a szökés, elrejtőzés veszélye a bűncselekmény kiemelkedő tárgyi súlyára, bizonyítottsága esetén kiszabható – öttől tíz évig terjedő szabadságvesztés – büntetés nagyságára és arra, hogy a gyanúsítottak kiterjedt külföldi kapcsolatrendszerrel rendelkeznek. Orbán Áron és F. Izabella esetében az eljárás befolyásolásának a veszélye is fennáll, mert a nyomozás irányára figyelemmel különösen a további személyi bizonyítást befolyásolhatnák, és feltételezhető az erre irányuló szándékuk is. G. Ben jelenléte az eljárásban a bíróság szerint bűnügyi felügyelet alkalmazásával is biztosítható. Ő a döntés értelmében nem hagyhatja el Magyarország területét, és nyomkövető eszközt kell viselnie. Szerdán dönt a bíróság a volt miniszterelnök öccsének letartóztatásáról. A vízumügy 2024 őszén vette kezdetét. Nyilvánossá vált egy hangfelvétel , amelyen Orbán Áron Héjj Dávid miniszterelnöki biztossal beszél arról, hogy a Külgazdasági és Külügyminisztériumhoz tartozó konzulok blokkolják a vízumkérelmeit. Orbán Áron – és a jelek szerint ugyancsak őrizetbe vett élettársa – évek óta juttatott vízumhoz olyan nem európai uniós állampolgárokat, akik ezért „nagyon komoly összeget” fizettek ki. A Telex korábban arról írt, hogy az érintettek azután is bizniszeltek vízumokkal, hogy 2024 őszén előbb a hatóságok, majd a sajtó is értesült az üzletükről. Ügyvédje az elfogás másnapján azt állította , hogy Orbán Áron már hetekkel korábban levélben jelentkezett a Nemzeti Vagyonvisszaszerzési és Vagyonvédelmi Hivatalnál (NVVH). Schalkház Éva Edit azt írta: „közölte valamennyi elérhetőségét, azt, hogy milyen időszakokban hol tartózkodik, és arról is tájékoztatást adott, hogy a lakásában és a cége székhelyén milyen iratok és egyéb tárgyak találhatóak, amik egy esetleges kutatásnál fontosak lehetnek”. Nem meglepő módon a kiválasztott legegyszerűbb ügyben halad a leggyorsabban a Nemzeti Vagyonvisszaszerzési és Vagyonvédelmi Hivatal, így hiába dübörög a Tisza Párt választóinak követelése, a főkolompos, Orbán Viktor még messze van attól, hogy a testvére cellatársa legyen. A bíróság egy hónapra elrendelte Orbán Áron letartóztatását, ott voltunk, amikor ezt követően rendőrautóban vitték el a Fővárosi Törvényszékről.
